title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #5 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What did Mary answer to the angel's message? (1 mark)
   A. Leave me
   B. I do not believe you
   C. I am the Lord's servant, may your word to me be fulfilled
   D. I must ask the king

2. Why could Zechariah not speak for a time? (1 mark)
   A. He was tired
   B. He did not believe the angel's words
   C. He was ill
   D. He was sad

3. Where was Zechariah when the angel appeared to him? (1 mark)
   A. On a mountain
   B. At home
   C. In the temple
   D. By the river

4. What is a miracle? (1 mark)
   A. A school lesson
   B. An amazing act that shows God's power
   C. A festival
   D. An ordinary meal

5. Which quality did Bartimaeus show when he kept shouting to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Pride
   C. Anger
   D. Faith and persistence

6. How many came back to thank Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. None
   B. One
   C. Nine
   D. Ten

7. Which verse says, "I am the resurrection and the life"? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Luke 7:14
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. John 11:25

8. Who had died in the story? (1 mark)
   A. The only son of a widow
   B. A soldier
   C. A king
   D. A priest

9. To reconcile means to: (1 mark)
   A. Run away
   B. Fight
   C. Become friends again after a quarrel
   D. Shout

10. What did Joseph say about what his brothers intended? (1 mark)
   A. You are enemies
   B. You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good
   C. You must leave
   D. You must pay

11. What did Jesus tell the man after telling the story of the Good Samaritan? (1 mark)
   A. Go and wait
   B. Go and count
   C. Go and do likewise
   D. Go and rest

12. What is a harambee? (1 mark)
   A. A holiday
   B. A school game
   C. A kind of fruit
   D. People pooling resources to help someone

13. Where is the parable of the lost coin found? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 12:1
   B. John 3:16
   C. Luke 15:8-10
   D. Acts 2:38

14. How many silver coins did the woman have? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Two
   C. Twelve
   D. Five

15. What does repentance do? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us proud
   B. It has no effect
   C. It draws us close to Christ
   D. It pushes us away from God

16. What did Nicodemus bring to prepare Jesus' body for burial? (1 mark)
   A. Gold
   B. Oil only
   C. Myrrh and aloes
   D. Bread

17. If a stranger tries to grab you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Give them your bag
   B. Go with them
   C. Stay silent
   D. Shout for help and run to a safe place

18. Who is a stranger? (1 mark)
   A. Your teacher
   B. Your cousin
   C. Your grandmother
   D. Someone you do not know

19. What does integrity mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being popular
   B. Copying others
   C. Being lucky
   D. Doing right when nobody is watching

20. What should you do if you broke a cup? (1 mark)
   A. Blame a sibling
   B. Run away
   C. Tell the truth and say sorry
   D. Hide it

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give two forms of dishonesty other than lying. (2 marks)

22. Explain what the story teaches about gratitude and give one example from school life. (4 marks)

23. Explain how John the Baptist prepared the way for Jesus and what we can learn about living righteously. (5 marks)

24. Explain how the early church shows that God's kingdom grew from a small beginning. (5 marks)

25. State two lessons from the parable of the lost coin. (2 marks)

26. Write the message of Luke 1:37 in your own words and describe a situation in which it can comfort a child. (4 marks)

27. Explain what Proverbs 12:19 means. (3 marks)

28. Name two needs that people may have. (2 marks)

29. Describe how the ten lepers showed faith. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — I am the Lord's servant, may your word to me be fulfilled
   Luke 1:38 records her humble answer.

2. B — He did not believe the angel's words
   Luke 1:20 says he would be silent because he did not believe.

3. C — In the temple
   He was burning incense in the temple.

4. B — An amazing act that shows God's power
   Miracles show God's power.

5. D — Faith and persistence
   He believed that Jesus could help him.

6. B — One
   Only one returned.

7. D — John 11:25
   John 11:25 records Jesus' words.

8. A — The only son of a widow
   The young man was her only son.

9. C — Become friends again after a quarrel
   Reconcile means to make peace.

10. B — You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good
   Genesis 50:20 records this.

11. C — Go and do likewise
   Luke 10:37 says, "Go and do likewise."

12. D — People pooling resources to help someone
   Harambee means pulling together to help.

13. C — Luke 15:8-10
   The parable is in Luke 15:8-10.

14. A — Ten
   She had ten silver coins.

15. C — It draws us close to Christ
   Repenting means turning to God for a new start.

16. C — Myrrh and aloes
   John 19:39 says he brought myrrh and aloes.

17. D — Shout for help and run to a safe place
   Shouting and running attract help.

18. D — Someone you do not know
   A stranger is someone you do not know.

19. D — Doing right when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty in private.

20. C — Tell the truth and say sorry
   Honesty and apology are right.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Cheating, blaming others, exaggerating, gossiping, breaking promises.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Jesus noticed that only one of the ten returned to thank Him. We should be thankful to God and to people. Example: thanking a teacher who helped with a difficult lesson.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the lesson, 1 for Jesus noticing, 1 for a school example, 1 for explanation of gratitude.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: John preached in the wilderness, called people to repent and baptised them, so their hearts were ready for Jesus. We can learn to turn away from sin, be honest and kind, pray, and tell others about Jesus by our example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for preaching, 1 for repentance, 1 for baptism or readiness, 1 for turning from sin, 1 for a righteous example.

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus began with a few disciples. On Pentecost about three thousand believed and were baptised. The church spread to many towns and countries, and today it is found in all the world including Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the few disciples, 1 for Pentecost, 1 for three thousand, 1 for spreading, 1 for today's church.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Every person is precious to God; God searches for the lost; heaven rejoices when someone repents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Nothing is impossible with God. It can comfort a child who is afraid before an exam or when a family member is very sick, because God can help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for a suitable situation, 2 for explaining how it comforts.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Truth lasts and is trusted, but lies are soon found out and do not last.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for truth lasting, 1 for lies not lasting, 1 for clear explanation.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing, shelter, medicine, school items, friendship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid need.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: They called out to Jesus; they obeyed His command to go to the priests before they were healed; one returned to give thanks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.
